title: Noah's Birds: Prophetic Pointers to Yeshua — Genesis 8:6-7, the raven
summary: Opens the section on Noah's birds, titled "Noah's Birds: Prophetic Pointers to yeshua", with Genesis 8:6-7: after forty days Noah opens the ark's window and sends out a raven, which flies here and there until the water dries up. "raven" is underlined and "ark" is highlighted in red.

text.text: Noah’s Birds: Prophetic Pointers to yeshua
6 After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark
7 and he sent out a raven, and it flew here and there until the water was dried up from the earth.

numbers.note: forty days before Noah opened the window
